description: Named ‘The World’s Most Comfortable Shoe’ by TIME Magazine, Allbirds shoes are soft, lightweight, breathable, and fit your every move. The brand began as direct to consumer, and has since expanded to many storefronts around the world, offering products made out of materials as diverse as wool, eucalyptus fiber, and sugarcane.

AminoChain has created software to help streamline the process of bio-sample donations. Through their platform, users can view their portal, track sample, and receive royalties for their contributions allowing participants to become part of the scientific process.

Known as “the ice cream Oprah fell in love with”, Ample Hills makes ice-cream the old-fashioned way – in small, handcrafted batches. They’re known as ‘Brooklyn’s freshest’ for using fresh, local, and all-natural ingredients – all made at their Red Hook Factory in Brookyn, NY. With scoop shops across the USA, Ample Hills’ whimsical flavors surprise and delight all ice cream lovers.

Banza made headlines with its first product, pasta made from chickpeas. Aside from being lower in carbs and higher in protein and fiber compared to traditional pasta, Banza is also gluten free. Of course it tastes great, earning its accolade as the fastest growing pasta brand in the USA.

Base offers affordable at-home lab testing plans paired with a smart app that brings the power of data science to increase health outcomes. Base helps users target specific areas of concern like sleep, stress, and energy.
Botany.io helps software development teams grow professionally to stay engaged and happy.
Brightside simplifies the path through depression. Brightside offers top quality treatment including medication and digital CBT, with the support of a dedicated doctor at every step.
Brilliant Chemistry makes finding side work easier. Receiving payment is painless, and with Brilliant Chemistry, you are in control.
Exclusively available with Uber, Cargo offers rideshare drivers the ability to earn more using their cartop display program.

Carmatic is a verticalized sales enablement platform for auto dealerships. The company’s software streamlines the end-to-end sales process from search to sale allowing dealers to maximize profitability.
Casper is the first direct-to-consumer online mattress provider, creating one perfect mattress at a price-point that everyone can love.

Cents offers vertical software powering laundry and dry-cleaning businesses. Cents’ software can be customized to meet the needs of self service or full-service laundry businesses helping them with point of sale, managing revenue, and delivery.
Cerebras builds critical chip solutions for artificial intelligence companies. The company is working on powering the next generation of AI models.

Cove is a solution created by Thirty Madison, t he human-first health company bringing specialized care and treatment to everyone. Cove administers personalized treatment and ongoing care to help people who suffer from chronic migraines. Cove offers virtual doctor visits, proven treatment options, and medication delivered directly to patients who need it.

Curve provides a virtual hospital solution to enable patients and doctors to be together in a patient’s moment of need. Curve’s platform is used by skilled nursing facilities, hospitals, and ambulance services. The telemedicine platform uses data analytics and health information exchange in order to surface the information providers need to ensure optimal outcomes and a one-of-a-kind care experience.

Dashworks is the missing home page for distributed teams. It connects with all cloud apps used by a company and allows team members to intelligently search for company knowledge that is scattered across documents, messages, emails, tickets, events, CRM records. It also lets users to stay updated with company-wide announcements, and learn more about their teammates through rich employee and team profiles.
Dataminr is an AI-driven platform that leverages public data sources and proprietary models to identify risks and threats.
EarthGrid is building the next generation of our electric grid using their patented plasma technology.
Edera has developed software to assist enterprises in enhancing their Kubernetes security by offering container isolation.
Edufii’s social learning platform offers athletes and their coaches a one-stop hub for skills development, performance tracking and stronger relationships.
FanAI is an AI-driven audience monetization platform focusing on eSports. FanAI helps eSports players and teams increase sponsorship revenues, and making fan data actionable.

Fanatics is a sports merchandise and memorabilia platform that brings fans closer to their teams. Beyond merchandise, the company includes physical and digital trading cards as well as online sports betting.
Flexport assists companies by managing their supply chain, bringing together all the key stakeholders into a single platform.

For Days is the first closed-loop fashion company. They offer organic basics that you can swap and recycle anytime. They’ve created a unique manufacturing and recycling process that allows customers to mail back worn shirts in exchange for new ones.
Gatsby makes trading options simple. Open an account within minutes and with as little as $10. Make trades for or against companies and ETFs, and with no commissions.
Stay safe and skip the waiting room. With Getlabs, patients can access lab appointments at home.

Heyday personalizes skincare to make a positive impact in people’s lives. Heyday offers personalized facials, curated products, and expert advice. Heyday’s Licensed Estheticians tailor treatment plans and help customers reach their skincare goals.
Hyperice provides products that have the power to unlock the potential within everyone. Helping everyone on earth move better, live better, and be better.
Interlune harvests natural resources that are abundant in space. Using their own machinery, Interlune will identify and bring resources such as Helium-3 back to Earth.

Iris Finance is the financial cockpit for consumer brands. The company’s platform is the single source of financial truth for CPG companies. The company is focused on serving the accounting or FP&A functions for modern consumer brands.

JetPack Aviation has been leading the micro personal vertical take off and landing (VTOL) industry for the past 10 years. JetPack Aviation designed and built the world’s first portable JetPack, which is capable of rapidly lifting a 220 lb pilot thousands of feet into the air which has a speed of over 155 mph (250 km/h), enabling users to purchase customized multi-purpose jet packs. Currently, JetPack Aviation is developing the Speeder – a small flying motorcycle that will revolutionize the way paramedics reach their patients, the way the military insert and extract personnel and medivac the injured.

Juice Press provides their customers with unpasteurized and unprocessed organic produce and supplements. Currently, they offer uniquely bottled beverages and super food smoothies as well as raw foods, hot soups, dried goods, desserts and cleanses.

Justpoint is leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) to improve inefficiencies in the consumer litigation industry. Justpoint has built their own Large Clinical Model (LCM) powering their AI to identify medications that could be litigated against.

Keeps is is a solution created by Thirty Madison, t he human-first health company bringing specialized care and treatment to everyone. Keeps provides RX hair loss treatment for men. The medication is delivered discretely to the patient each month, avoiding the hassle of the pharmacy.
Krane offers a tech-driven solution to manage each phase of a construction project. Using AI, Krane enables project managers to quickly search for documents and remain informed on each project.

Kredit works with debt collectors to help them reach consumers through different channels focusing on automating the negotiations between consumers and financial advisors. Through Kredit, financial advisors have an all-in-one platform to have consumers resolve their own balances or work with someone.
Kyte is the best way to get a car – for a day, a few days or a few weeks – delivered to people’s doorsteps. Kyte’s vision is to provide people with better access to fewer cars

Lancium, headquartered in Texas, the company builds critical infrastructure to help manage energy usage for large enterprises. Lancium is helping these organizations switch to more renewable sources of energy.
Lifeforce is the go-to platform for anyone looking to better optimize their health and wellness. The company provides people with diagnostic testing, health tips and ways to enhance their hormones.

LoanStreet offers the first fully integrated online platform that streamlines the process of sharing, managing, and originating loans. LoanStreet’s turnkey solutions help: Credit Unions, Banks, Direct Lenders and Loan Investors.

Platform designed to empower all owners of art. We are redefining what it means to be an owner — it is not just collectors, but at Lobus, we are on a mission to make artists owners and to put them in control.

Mate Fertility is a group of fertility doctors making the path to parenthood less complicated, less expensive, and a lot more accessible. Mate Fertility has created a network of fertility centers run by experts who care, a branded experience that brings all resources under one roof, state-of-the-art treatments clearly explained and easily kept track of, and services delivered in a positive, warm environment.

Monument is a telehealth platform designed to help people reduce their consumption of alcohol. Monument works with each patient to design a treatment that may include therapy, medication and/or a support group.

MyMarkit is the first transactional blockchain that mines ledgers directly from live transactions across various points of commerce. With SAAS and blockchain digital platforms that propagate ledgers across their fintech ecosystem, MyMarkit is able to provide first-of-its-kind solutions for everyday access to blockchain utility. Various products include universal multiprocessors, digital wallets, blockchain marketplaces, blockchain ecommerce, blockchain marketing analytics, universal currency, blockchain automation for fulfillment processes, authentication/verification, and many other use cases.
Neuronspike is developing and manufacturing chips designed for generative AI. Using their chips, enterprises can more efficiently power large language models.
Nuzzel solves social overload with a platform that shows you the top news stories shared by friends, in a super-easy interface available via web, mobile, and email.

OpenAI is a leading artificial intelligence research and deployment company. It is the driving force behind ChatGPT, an advanced conversational AI that empowers users to ask questions, generate content and interact with information.
Paxafe provides AI enabled software to support cold chain logistics. Paxafe provides actionable insights to help companies reduce their risk ultimately improving their respective supply chains.
Perplexity is a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question.

“Reinventing credit for the mobile generation.” The Petal Card is the solution for the underserved millennial credit card market. Millennials, who love technology and convenience, will now have a credit card providing a digital experience that brings simplicity, transparency and ease of use.
Pipe transforms recurring revenue into upfront capital for growth without debt or dilution.
Platejoy creates personalized meal plans tailored to your needs. Recipes are based off of each individual’s diet and what their fitness goals require.
Polymarket is a decentralized prediction market where users trade on the outcomes of real-world events.

Postmates is transforming the way goods move around cities by enabling anyone to have anything delivered on-demand. Their revolutionary Urban Logistics platform connects customers with local couriers who can deliver anything from any store or restaurant in minutes.

Preczn is a fintech operations platform for vertical software companies. The platform provides software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies with a unified dashboard to manage their fintech data and integrations.
Privateer operates an on-demand space data platform. The company does not own any assets and instead provides satellite operators with their technology.
For an affordable price, Pure Growth Organics offers natural, organic food with absolutely no additives, chemicals, or artificial ingredients.
PYM’s (Prepare Your Mind) mission is to provide safe and effective stress and anxiety relief products while building a movement to support mental health.

Railz provides a single API to all major accounting software service providers used by Small Business customers. Their solution provides on-demand, real-time access to this information with a single API.

RecoverX is revolutionizing injury recovery for all athletes, from recreational to professional. Their first product is the world’s first smartphone controlled electric cold and heat device, designed for the knee.
Recursive is building the infrastructure layer that allows AI agents to operate autonomously across digital environments.

Founded by Tom Brady, Michael Strahan & Gotham Chopra, Religion of Sports uses multi-media to tell the true stories of athletes, enabling a deeper and more positive look into the spiritual and inspirational nature of sports.

Revolv3 is a full stack SaaS payment optimization platform for subscription billing utilizing adaptive technology to deliver the industry’s highest credit card acceptance rates. Our seamless integration enables merchants to instantly achieve transformational revenue growth and superior customer retention at the lowest cost in the industry.
Rightfoot enables businesses to get consumer permissioned data without users logging into their accounts. Through Rightfoot, companies get a constantly updating financial snapshot of their users.

Riide manufactures and sells electric bikes specifically designed for the modern, urban professional. Their unique design allows for the rider to pedal, twist the throttle, or do both at once. Riide bikes are designed with durability and safety first.

Roman delivers E.D. Medication discretely and directly to your doorstep. Most men don’t want to consult their doctor about the symptoms of Erectile Dysfunction. With Roman’s revolutionary Telemedicine solution, patients consult a doctor online quickly, and receive their prescription discretely, all while saving the trip to the doctor’s office. Roman is powered by Ro, a patient-driven telehealth company that aims to be a patient’s first call for all of their healthcare needs.
Roomi is the leading marketplace for shared housing and apartments. Roomi App helps you find roommates you love and flexible co-living options that feel like home.

Rory is a digital health clinic for women’s health. Rory is powered by Ro, a patient-driven telehealth company that aims to be a patient’s first call for all of their healthcare needs. Using technology, Ro empowers physicians to provide high-quality, affordable care when and where patients need it most.

Recycle Track Systems is a licensed waste and recycling company based in New York City. RTS combines best in class customer service with technology to give clients like CitiField and FedExField a superior experience. RTS was created out of necessity to help fix chronic service issues plaguing the waste management and recycling industry.
Rubrik is a cybersecurity company that helps ensure data is protected when there is a breach. Rubrik helps enterprises prevent critical interruptions and data leaks.

Rumble is founded by four entrepreneurs who saw an opening in the group fitness world to shake up stale norms. From their unique backgrounds—hospitality, service, and fitness education—and their shared urban-chic-meets-street point of view, comes Rumble—the next generation of group fitness. One that doesn’t take itself too seriously, but still delivers an incredible and effective workout.
Scale AI provides the essential data to fuel the next generation of models for large enterprises. Through Scale’s Data Engine, machine learning teams can swiftly identify any errors and scale models.

SelfMade helps entrepreneurs and small businesses elevate their online presence through social media and email marketing support. By providing professional photo editing services and assets on-demand, the SelfMade team creates effortless brand growth while entrepreneurs focus on building their businesses.

Shotzoom empowers the world’s largest digital coaching community through a family of mobile applications. Over 3 million coaches, athletes, and fans in 200 countries rely on Shotzoom apps to coach, train, and play smarter.
Skyryse has developed a hardware and software operating system, FlightOS, to power all general aviation (GA) aircraft, enabling safer, more capable, and more accessible flight.
SpaceX designs and manufactures rockets and spacecrafts for the next generation of space exploration.

SquareFoot is changing the way businesses find and rent office space. Squarefoot puts proprietary data and technology at the fingertips of landlords, tenants, and brokers, streamlining a historically arduous matchmaking process. Their team of technologists and brokers has helped more than 500 companies solve their real estate needs, nationwide.

Stake works with building owners and operators, enabling them to reward their tenants with cash back for paying their rent on time. Beyond cash back, renters get access to a debit card and tools to help them build their credit score for paying rent.
Sunairio is a software company that simulates energy assets to help businesses and organizations drive insights and investments.

Taiki is the API infrastructure layer for tax automation. Instead of manually collecting tax documents, users connect their financial institutions and Taiki automatically gathers the forms and data from payroll and financial providers.

Tapcart is a software company offering a no code solution for brands to launch mobile apps. Tapcart wants to drive more customer engagement, in a cost-effective way, giving brands a way to use mobile devices to do it.

TenToOne is a contemporary and elevated blend, created to challenge expectations and reinvigorate the way people taste, experience, and talk about rum. Born in the Caribbean, TenToOne White and Dark rums celebrate the beauty in the blend of flavors from Barbados, Trinidad & Tobago, Jamacia, and the Dominican Republic. Join the celebration, and ask for TenToOne in your favorite restaurant, bar, or liquor store.

Thirty Madison is a human-first healthcare company bringing specialized care and treatment to everyone. Thirty Madison is the parent company of condition-specific brands known as: Keeps, Cove, Evens, and Picnic. From diagnosis to condition management, Thirty Madison breaks down the basics to make caring for complex conditions as straightforward and transparent as possible.

Thread sells software to power autonomous inspection of electric utilities and generation. Using Thread, enterprises can more efficiently capture data and provide actionable insights to proactively maintain assets.

Tortoise can safely drive any small electric vehicle from a location where it’s underutilized or obstructing the road, to a city-approved parking spot, a public transit hub, and in the near-future, your doorstep.

TrueFacet is a modern alternative for buying and selling jewelry and watches. TrueFacet’s online platform is rooted in trust, transparency, and authenticity, where both buyers and sellers get the best value for their item, period.

Trust & Will is modernizing the trust and estate planning industry with an easy, fast, and secure way to set up estate plan online. Since 2017, Trust & Will has helped more than 160,000+ families with a better way to plan for the future.
Twine offers a set of professional networking tools for event owners. Unlike one-to-many or few-to-many video broadcasts, twine connects a small number of people for more intimate conversations.
Voyager Space creates the necessary infrastructure to explore space including commercial space stations.

Voyajoy helps real estate investors, developers, and traditional property managers increase income with less hassle. Their unique software allows them to leverage data and manage multiple short-term rental units seamlessly.

Wheels Up provides private aviation options with flexible benefits and travel routes. With the belief that existing programs within the industry are antiquated, Wheels Up was founded by Bill Allard and current CEO Kenny Dichter to bring the best parts of private aviation to a new group of consumers.
Whoop is a wearable device measuring a person’s fitness and health. Whoop can help people track their sleep and recovery providing insights into one’s day to day health journey.

YellowDig is a social collaboration tool that brings knowledge from outside of the classroom into the course material. YellowDig turns the classroom into a learning community where students can learn from any source, anytime, anywhere, and from any device. Students that use YellowDig Engage express 90% satisfaction and want to use it again. YellowDig Engage reduces course drops by 8 percent, resulting in better overall outcomes for students and instructors.

YouStake is the first marketplace where fans can directly sponsor their favorite players in poker and eSports while sharing the winnings. YouStake is a simple and safe environment where fans can provide skilled players the access to capital needed to reach their superstar potential.

ZenBusiness is the only personalized business formation service allowing you to register your company, secure your employer identification number, and more, at little to no cost. Experience the seamless platform and get your venture off the ground with just a few clicks.

Zero’s treatment plan assists those who want to quit smoking with physician-prescribed medication to curb cravings and nicotine gum to reduce withdrawal symptoms. Zero is powered by Ro, a patient-driven telehealth company that aims to be a patient’s first call for all of their healthcare needs.

Zero Bond is the preeminent private membership club bringing together people from diverse paths of life into one place, fostering a community touching on art, politics, sports, business and the humanities, fueled by contemporary culture. Zero Bond is the benchmark for the ‘third space’, a space that is neither home nor work, but offers the best of both.
Zest is an all-in-one cooking app that helps users with recipes, tips and grocery shopping. Zest takes users on a guided journey of how to cook meals and tracks your progress.
Zocdoc is an online marketplace connecting patients with in-network doctors. Beyond booking appointments, patients can view reviews and confirm insurance coverage from a tech first solution.

Zoneomics is a platform that standardizes and aggregates zoning data that can be inferenced by AI and provides access through an API. By eliminating the need to visit city offices, Zoneomics saves teams time and resources.
